templates.topic: How to freeze and ship the Mosaic OAT
keys: how do i ship the oat
how long can it stay frozen
templates.answer: Collection cup + gel pack (laid flat) in the freezer, minimum 4 hours before shipping. Frozen sample is viable 30 days after collection. Ship: cup → biohazard zip-lock with absorbent sheet → silver thermo bag with gel pack → cardboard kit box.
templates.reply:
Hello [Name],

Happy to walk you through it!

Put the collection cup and the gel pack in the freezer, laying the gel pack flat. They need to stay frozen at least 4 hours before shipping, and you can keep them in there until you're ready to send it — your frozen sample stays viable for 30 days after collection.

When you ship: collection cup into the biohazard zip-lock with the absorbent sheet, then the sample and frozen gel pack into the silver thermo bag, then that into the cardboard kit box.

Let us know if anything's missing from your kit and we'll get it sorted!

Best,
[Your name]

templates.topic: OAT — what to avoid before collecting
templates.answer: Antibiotics: finish the course and wait 14 days. Avoid 48 hours before: apples, grapes/raisins, pears, cranberries and anything made from them (incl. apple cider vinegar, apple pectin, wine), echinacea, reishi, arabinogalactan, ribose. Collect first morning urine before eating or drinking, minimum 10 mL.
templates.caution: Anything not on this list gets routed. Never say whether a slip-up has ruined the sample.
templates.reply:
Hello [Name],

Happy to share these! For the OAT:

If you're on antibiotics, finish the course and wait 14 days before collecting.

For 48 hours beforehand, avoid apples, grapes and raisins, pears, cranberries and anything made from them — including apple cider vinegar, apple pectin, and wine — plus echinacea, reishi mushrooms, arabinogalactan, and ribose supplements.

On collection day, catch your first morning urine before eating or drinking anything, and you'll need at least 10 mL.

If anything you're taking isn't on that list, let me know and I'll check rather than guess!

Best,
[Your name]

templates.topic: Vibrant TotalTox — prep and binder
templates.answer: Binder on protocol 2 days before collecting (ViRadChem on the e-store, or activated charcoal / bentonite clay). Avoid 48 hours: seafood, seaweed/kelp, dairy, Brazil nuts, anything high in iodine or selenium. Fasting not required. No more than 8 oz water in the hour before.
templates.caution: Optional Epsom bath or sauna the night before can aid provocation — mention only as the lab's own optional note, never as advice.
templates.reply:
Hello [Name],

Happy to help! For your TotalTox collection:

You'll want a binder on your protocol consistently for at least 2 days beforehand. If you haven't met with your practitioner yet, ViRadChem is available on our e-store, and activated charcoal or bentonite clay work as well.

For 48 hours before, avoid seafood, seaweed and kelp, dairy, Brazil nuts, and other foods high in iodine or selenium. Fasting isn't required. And please don't drink more than 8 oz of water in the hour before you collect.

Let us know if you have any questions about any of it!

Best,
